title: Investigating the Valuation Effects of Announcements of Voluntary Corporate Selloffs

rival_explanations: model misspecification (the observed abnormal returns are an artifact of the return-generating model rather than real information effects)
model misspecification (the pre-event negative abnormal returns are an artifact of the return-generating model rather than a real information release)

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (New York Stock Exchange-listed parent firms making voluntary corporate selloffs)

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: overall test sample N = 53 selloffs (announced 1964-1973, NYSE-listed) and subsample N = 39 firms with no other selloff announcements

dv.name: abnormal stock return around selloff announcement
dv.measure: cumulative average residual returns (CARs), t = -30 through t = +30, computed as deviations from mean-adjusted expected return using three estimation procedures (both-but-separate, both-combined, pre-only)

analyses.label: Table II - t-tests of cumulative average standardized residual returns (CASRs)
analyses.sample: test sample N = 53 (with a paired control sample of 53 firms drawn from CRSP for the model-misspecification check)

dv.name: abnormal stock return (standardized)
dv.measure: cumulative average standardized residual returns (CASRs) and associated t-statistics over event windows: two-day announcement period (t = -1, 0), overall CASR (t = -30 to +30 excluding t = -1 and t = 0), pre-event CASR (t = -30 through t = -2), and post-event CASR; tested under three estimation procedures plus a Market Adjusted Returns technique (residuals as Rit - Rmt vs. CRSP equally-weighted index)

key_ivs.name: voluntary corporate selloff announcement
key_ivs.measure: announcement date (event day t = 0) from the Wall Street Journal; two-day (t = -1, 0), pre-event, post-event, and overall event windows

constructs: financial characteristics of firms announcing selloffs and spinoffs

proposed_edge.from: financial characteristics of firms announcing selloffs and spinoffs
